description: This file defines the RestJsonSerializer class, which serializes requests for the REST-JSON protocol in the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the RestSerializer class and provides methods to handle JSON payload formatting and setting appropriate HTTP headers.

classes.name: RestJsonSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that handles serialization of requests for the REST-JSON protocol in AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the serializer with the API description, endpoint, and optional JSON formatter.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Prepares the request payload by serializing the given StructureShape value to JSON and setting HTTP headers.
